วัด / อุโบสถ (Thai temple ordination hall): Symmetrical frontal view along a straight terracotta-tiled walkway leading to a white Buddhist ordination hall on a platform surrounded by water. The hall has a steep, layered roof in white and pale pink with long pointed finials, a gold-brown carved gable pediment, white walls and a pair of carved golden doors, reached by about eight reddish-brown steps. White balustrades enclose the platform. Two tall black lamp posts with three cream globe lamps each stand in the foreground, and roughly eight more lamp posts line the approach (count unclear). Potted pink bougainvillea in terracotta pots line both sides; grey railings border the water. About six pigeons stand on the walkway. A red-and-white Thai sign is on the left railing and a blue Thai sign on the right. Large tree at right; smaller trees at left. Bright daytime, hazy sky with light clouds.
